_comment: Transcribed from in-game screenshots taken 2026-08-18, the day 1.4.2.0 went live (Steam captures 20260818125320 Pax Armata art, 125323 Pax Armata loadout, 125329 NATO loadout). The page leads with the in-game class name, which is the title the vehicle screen shows; the model designation rides underneath. No slot screen was opened on this airframe, so every slot records only the option the loadout bar showed as equipped. Sibling class Multirole Jet was captured in full on the same day and shares several of these option names, but nothing has been copied across: two jets naming a slot the same way is not evidence they carry the same weapon, and the Attack Helicopter / IFV precedent is that they often do not.
name: Interceptor Jet
_alias_note: EA's own 1.4.2.0 changelog spells it both ways - "F-74A Seacat" in the summary and "F74A Seacat" in the Portal line - so both are aliases.
_traits_note: The pill row printed under the class name on the vehicle screen. The other eleven vehicles carry the same row in game and it was simply not recorded when they were captured, so its absence there is a gap and not a difference.

description.text: This fleet defense fighter specializes in air-to-air combat with limited air-to-ground capability.

_loadout_note: Seven slots, and no Upgrade slot on either seat - every other jet has a Driver Upgrade. Every slot is locked: this aircraft cannot be customised at all, confirmed by the project owner from play on 2026-08-18, which is why the rows give the equipped item and no option list. That is a stronger claim than the capture alone supports - the loadout row was shot on both factions but no slot screen was opened - so the source for it is the owner and not the screenshots. Flares is likewise fixed and not customisable anywhere, which matches every other aircraft in the database. Two Gunner slots share the name Remote Weapon, the same shape the Attack Helicopter, Scout Helicopter and Patrol Boat already use.
_variant_note: Both factions field the same model here; only the livery differs, so the two captures show one aircraft in NATO and Pax Armata colors. The same is true of the Transport Helicopter and the Patrol Boat.
_image_note: Cropped from the Customize screen (Steam captures 20260818175000 NATO, 20260818175004 Pax Armata), not the Cosmetic Customization screen the other eleven vehicles use, because no capture of that screen exists for these two. Consequences, so nobody wonders later: the frame is 1500x422 rather than the 1500x780 the rest share, because the only band clear of the header, the callout and the loadout row is that shallow; and a faint callout leader line and the small square hardpoint reticle sit on the airframe, since both are drawn over the aircraft and no crop removes them. Both figures on a page use one geometry so they match each other. Nothing was painted out - cropping is framing, retouching would be inventing. Replace these if the Cosmetic Customization screen is ever captured.
